Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief jobs-report update says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant describes an alpine-inspired dining experience with traditional Swiss dishes such as cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. The site highlights cozy wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The introduction and email address make it clear whose site it is and how to contact you. Based on the content available, I’d suggest adding a short bio and a few examples of your interests or projects so visitors get a better sense of who you are. A descriptive page heading could also make the introduction more engaging.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking gives your blog a personal focus and a good starting point for connecting with readers who share that interest. Based on the content available, I’d love to see stories about your favorite hikes, photos, and practical trail tips. A short introduction about what readers can expect from the blog would also help draw them in.
